purpose: Separate persona-weight effects, exogenous Jinn-versus-Beast membrane effects, and their interaction on a fresh moral-control-mesh universe.

weights: persona checkpoint selected by the frozen v4 endpoint rule

primary_estimands.membrane_effect_under_base: Jinn membrane minus Beast membrane executed-process metrics under base weights.
primary_estimands.membrane_effect_under_adapter: Jinn membrane minus Beast membrane executed-process metrics under selected persona weights.
primary_estimands.adapter_effect_under_jinn: Selected persona weights minus base under Jinn membrane.
primary_estimands.adapter_effect_under_beast: Selected persona weights minus base under Beast membrane.
primary_estimands.interaction: Adapter membrane effect minus base membrane effect.

claim_boundary.primary_claim: Observable process interaction between frozen exogenous membranes and a separately trained persona adapter.
